summary: First testing pass on AlphaScribe MVP. All 10 backend pytest cases passed and full UI E2E flow (Dashboard -> Run Pipeline -> ReportView with SSE -> Sidebar history -> Ingest page) succeeded. Multi-agent LangGraph pipeline verified end-to-end including retry loop (fact-checker flagged 1/10 -> synthesizer retry 1 -> all 10 verified).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _run_pipeline: `new_trace = trace[emitted_events:] if False else trace` — dead conditional; the `if False` means the slice is never taken. Works because each node returns only its own new trace entries, but the intent is confusing and `emitted_events` counter is unused. Consider removing.

server.py stream_report replays JOBS[job_id]['events'] and then reads from the queue — for a fast-completing job the queue may already have items pushed and the sentinel may be consumed by the replay-then-await loop cleanly, but there is a mild race if two subscribers attach to the same job (only one will get final). Acceptable for MVP.

JOBS + JOB_QUEUES are in-memory only; report data is persisted to Mongo (good), but if the server restarts mid-run, the SSE stream endpoint returns 404. Consider persisting job status too. Non-blocking for MVP.
Dashboard.jsx sample query testId uses `sample-query-${q.length}` — length-based IDs are fragile if two queries share length. Prefer an index or slug.
